packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time CRM contacts section has a readable preview/empty state, mobile-safe contact review cards, and screenshot coverage without adding external CRM writes.

title: Operations CRM Contact Detail Polish

reasons: The remaining register gap calls out CRM/contact-detail polish after the IA/nav cleanup.
The latest participants screenshots show the member roster is readable, but the CRM Contacts section still needs explicit screenshot coverage and stronger empty/detail states.
The fix can be scoped to first-party One Time CRM review UI and audit/test coverage, with no GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM, send, payment, or access mutation.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this CRM/contact-detail polish, continue only if manual screenshot review finds more defects, or move to deploy/live-smoke once DEC-20260702-801 is resolved.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time CRM/contact section feel clean and useful even when the local workspace has no loaded contacts, and make populated CRM rows mobile-safe without changing no-send or external-write policy.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No backend authorization, allowed-view policy, database query, route registry, action registry, payment, email, access grant, account, DNS, send, publish, upload, or external-provider mutation.
No GHL runtime, LeadConnector runtime, external CRM client, or external CRM write.
No removal of diagnostic support routes used by Shloimie/Codex; this packet only demotes them from the primary Rabbi sidebar.
affected_surfaces: One Time CRM contact review rows

inspection_targets: public/operations.html workspaceNavViewIds, workspaceNavItems, renderSidebar, renderSidebarModuleList, currentNavItem, switchView, setCurrentSection
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: CRM Contacts has no dedicated screenshot capture in the main Rabbi / One Time audit route set.
When no CRM rows are loaded, the empty state is a single plain sentence rather than a scannable no-send/import/setup status surface.

When CRM rows are loaded, the review pattern is an eight-column table that needs a mobile-friendly contact-card representation for names, contact detail, no-send, dedupe, source, communications, next action, and direct actions.

expanded_phrases.clean: The sidebar should read as a Rabbi-facing work console, not a raw internal platform index.
expanded_phrases.even: Primary modules should use consistent short labels, markers, section targets, and active states across desktop and mobile.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The first rendered Operations viewport should expose the relevant One Time modules without a long platform-module wall or layout jump.
expanded_phrases.CRM: Interpret CRM as first-party BNA/One Time contact review UX only: list/detail review, no-send state, dedupe state, source provenance, communication readback, and guarded direct actions. Do not add GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM APIs, or external CRM writes.
expanded_phrases.community section: Community/class work remains first-party One Time classroom/community data and may be grouped under Rabbi modules without cross-workspace record bleed.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use the existing Rabbi IA and first-party BNA Operations routes. Support modules remain routable for diagnostics but are demoted from the Rabbi-facing primary sidebar.

requirements.statement: Polish the One Time CRM Contacts route so empty and populated contact-review states are readable, mobile-safe, and clearly no-send/no-external-write.
requirements.expected_result: The CRM Contacts section shows a structured no-contact setup/preview state when rows are absent, shows mobile-safe contact review cards when rows exist, and the audit captures the CRM route on desktop/tablet/mobile.
acceptance_criteria: The audit route list includes contacts crm_contacts and captures desktop, tablet, and mobile screenshots.
The empty CRM state renders a structured first-party CRM status surface with source, no-send, dedupe, and next-step information.
Populated CRM rows have a card representation with contact, status, no-send, dedupe, source, communications, next action, and existing direct actions.
No GHL, LeadConnector, external CRM write, send, payment, checkout, access grant, DNS, or provider account mutation is introduced.
Focused CRM static tests and the full local audit pass.

criteria: RAW-20260702-008 and the broad UI cleanup register exist.
REQ-20260702-821 locally verified the main One Time IA/nav alignment.
Latest participant screenshots show member roster readability but no dedicated CRM Contacts capture.
Existing tests already assert first-party CRM scoping/no-send/dedupe behavior.
Implementation can stay in Operations UI, audit route list, and focused static tests only.
